0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 1-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak) are 13th in the West and 3 games back in the Northwest as they play their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, hosting the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, on a one-game win streak), who are 9th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest. The teams have not met yet this season, but they split their 2025-26 series 1-2 in the Jazz's disfavor, and their most recent meeting was a 126-109 Spurs win in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
